## Outcome

Describe the user or operational outcome and link the relevant issue or decision.

## Changes

- Summarize the smallest set of meaningful changes.

## Validation

- List each command or manual check run and its result.

## Risk and rollout

- Describe security, privacy, data, compatibility, cost, and operational risks.
- Describe rollout, rollback, and any follow-up work.

## Checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are met.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and important failure paths.
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs are current.
- [ ] No secrets or unnecessary sensitive data are included.
